contentPattern: One row per tip group (2 rows on the source), 2 cells: [picture: icon (green check / red X)] | [h3 'Do' or 'Don't' + bullet list; keep the line break and poison-control parenthetical in the 2nd Don't item verbatim]. Tone class per row: 'negative' when the heading starts with Don't / Do not / Avoid / Never, 'positive' when it starts with Do, otherwise rows alternate positive/negative; the tone colours the heading. Typically in a section with Style: flower, Tab: patient.
